name: Afterzoid Shader Pack 5
author: AlipFX
description: A collection of native Panzoid GLSL shader effects.

effects.name: "Take On Me" Paper
effects.description: Creates a pencil-and-paper illustration with hatched shading.

effects.name: 4-Color Gradient
effects.description: Creates a four-color gradient from positioned color points.

effects.name: 8Bit PixCam
effects.description: Pixelates the image with a four-color dithered palette.

effects.name: A_Bayangan
effects.description: Creates a soft colored shadow from the source alpha.

effects.name: A_Flutter
effects.description: Animates the layer as a fluttering paper leaf with folds and wobble.

effects.name: A_Glossy
effects.description: Adds a glossy highlight from the source alpha.

effects.name: A_HalfDots
effects.description: Renders the image as configurable halftone dots.

effects.name: A_InnerGradation
effects.description: Applies layered gradients to selected source colors.

effects.name: A_Outline
effects.description: Generates colored outlines from the source alpha.

effects.name: A_StarTrail
effects.description: Generates animated star trails with configurable shapes and colors.

effects.name: A_Wiggle
effects.description: Animates position, scale, and rotation with procedural noise.

effects.name: After Effects Mirror
effects.description: Reflects the layer across a configurable mirror axis.

effects.name: AnalogTV
effects.description: Simulates an analog CRT display.

effects.name: Apple II Pixelated DHGR
effects.description: Creates Apple II DHGR-style pixel art.

effects.name: Apple II Pixelated HGR
effects.description: Creates Apple II HGR-style pixel art.

effects.name: ASCII
effects.description: Renders the image with procedural ASCII characters.

effects.name: Atomico
effects.description: Renders an animated Bohr-model atom with orbiting electrons.

effects.name: AZ Bend It
effects.description: Bends the layer between two configurable points.

effects.name: AZ Bender
effects.description: Applies selectable geometric bend styles.

effects.name: AZ Blobbylize
effects.description: Fuses nearby image regions into soft blobs.

effects.name: AZ Block Load
effects.description: Reveals the image through a grid of blocks.

effects.name: AZ Bubbles
effects.description: Adds animated wobbling bubbles over the image.

effects.name: AZ Burn Film
effects.description: Creates an animated film-burn transition.

effects.name: AZ Cross Blur
effects.description: Blurs the image along horizontal and vertical axes.

effects.name: AZ Cylinder
effects.description: Wraps the layer around a rotatable 3D cylinder.

effects.name: AZ Drizzle
effects.description: Adds animated raindrop ripples and spreading rings.

effects.name: AZ Glass
effects.description: Creates a refractive glass relief from image height.

effects.name: AZ Grid Wipe
effects.description: Transitions the image through a tiled grid.

effects.name: AZ Griddler
effects.description: Rearranges the image into scaled and rotated tiles.

effects.name: AZ HexTile
effects.description: Reprojects the layer into a hexagonal tile pattern.

effects.name: AZ Jaws
effects.description: Reveals or conceals the layer with a jaws-shaped wipe.

effects.name: AZ Kaleida
effects.description: Creates a kaleidoscopic reflection from a movable region.

effects.name: AZ Lens
effects.description: Applies a radial lens warp around a chosen center.

effects.name: AZ Light Burst 2.5
effects.description: Adds a radial burst of light and rays.

effects.name: AZ Light Rays
effects.description: Draws directional or radial light rays.

effects.name: AZ Light Sweep
effects.description: Sweeps a colored light band across the layer.

effects.name: AZ Light Wipe
effects.description: Reveals the source with a directional light wipe.

effects.name: AZ Line Sweep
effects.description: Reveals the layer with a slanted moving line.

effects.name: AZ Plastic
effects.description: Creates a plastic-like surface from source edges.

effects.name: AZ Radial Blur
effects.description: Applies a radial or spin blur from a center.

effects.name: AZ Radial Fast Blur
effects.description: Applies a lightweight radial zoom blur.

effects.name: AZ Radial ScaleWipe
effects.description: Transitions the layer through radial scale expansion.

effects.name: AZ Rainfall
effects.description: Adds animated falling raindrops over the image.

effects.name: AZ Scale Wipe
effects.description: Reveals the image with a directional scale wipe.

effects.name: AZ Scatterize
effects.description: Scatters image samples with a randomized displacement field.

effects.name: AZ Slant
effects.description: Slants the layer along a chosen axis.

effects.name: AZ Snowfall
effects.description: Adds animated snowflakes with depth and wind.

effects.name: AZ Sphere
effects.description: Maps the layer onto a rotatable 3D sphere.

effects.name: AZ Split
effects.description: Splits the layer along a line between two points.

effects.name: AZ Split 2
effects.description: Creates a two-stage directional split.

effects.name: AZ Threads
effects.description: Renders the image as overlapping directional threads.

effects.name: AZ Threshold
effects.description: Converts the source into a threshold mask.

effects.name: AZ Threshold RGB
effects.description: Thresholds the red, green, and blue channels independently.

effects.name: AZ Tiler
effects.description: Repeats and scales the source around a center.

effects.name: AZ Toner
effects.description: Maps luminance into selectable color tone ramps.

effects.name: AZ Vector Blur
effects.description: Blurs the image along a source-derived vector field.

effects.name: BCC Ripple Dissolve
effects.description: Dissolves the layer with a propagating ripple ring.

effects.name: Better Ramp
effects.description: Creates a linear or radial two-color ramp.

effects.name: Better Ramp V2
effects.description: Creates a multi-stop linear or radial gradient.

effects.name: Bevel Alpha
effects.description: Adds a beveled edge from the source alpha.

effects.name: Block Dissolve
effects.description: Reveals or removes the source in random blocks.

effects.name: Box Roll Transition
effects.description: Assembles the image from boxes that roll in across a grid.

effects.name: Box Roll Transition (Reverse)
effects.description: Disassembles the image into boxes that roll away across a grid.

effects.name: Brush Strokes
effects.description: Repaints the source as randomized brush strokes.

effects.name: Bubble Fill
effects.description: Fills the frame with organic bubbles that reveal the source.

effects.name: Burn Transition
effects.description: Burns through the layer with an animated charred edge.

effects.name: Cartoon
effects.description: Creates a cartoon treatment with flattened colors and edges.

effects.name: Change Color
effects.description: Shifts selected colors by hue, saturation, and lightness.

effects.name: Change To Color
effects.description: Replaces selected colors while preserving image luminance.

effects.name: Channel Mixer
effects.description: Remixes red, green, blue, and alpha channels.

effects.name: Checkerboard
effects.description: Generates a configurable checkerboard pattern.

effects.name: ChromAbba
effects.description: Separates and curves RGB channels around a center.

effects.name: Circle
effects.description: Draws a positioned circle or ring.

effects.name: Clay
effects.description: Gives the image a molded clay appearance.

effects.name: Color Balance
effects.description: Adjusts shadows, midtones, and highlights by color.

effects.name: Color Balance (HSL)
effects.description: Adjusts color balance with HSL controls.

effects.name: Colorama
effects.description: Maps image color through a cyclic color palette.

effects.name: ColorVSN
effects.description: Applies selectable scientific and artistic color maps.

effects.name: Commodore64 Pixelated
effects.description: Creates Commodore 64-style pixel art.

effects.name: Corner Pin
effects.description: Warps the source into a four-corner quadrilateral.

effects.name: CR-LumaRamp
effects.description: Maps luminance through a selectable color ramp.

effects.name: CRTX Lite
effects.description: Simulates a lightweight curved CRT display.

effects.name: Curl Noise
effects.description: Distorts the layer with a procedural curl-noise field.

effects.name: Curves
effects.description: Adjusts RGB channels or alpha with cubic curves.

effects.name: Cyanotype
effects.description: Creates a cyanotype print treatment.

effects.name: Deep Glow
effects.description: Creates a multi-directional glow from bright source areas.

effects.name: Dot Pixel
effects.description: Converts the image into spherical or ring-shaped dots.

effects.name: Double Slash Transition
effects.description: Slashes through the layer with two glowing diagonal cuts.

effects.name: Drop Shadow
effects.description: Generates a filtered drop shadow from the source alpha.

effects.name: E Scopes
effects.description: Overlays exposure scopes with a configurable graticule and labels.

effects.name: Echo
effects.description: Creates an echo trail from time-offset frames.

effects.name: Echo V2
effects.description: Composites repeated time-offset frames into an echo.

effects.name: Element Glow
effects.description: Creates a colored gradient glow from selected source areas.

effects.name: Ellipse
effects.description: Draws a positioned ellipse or elliptical ring.

effects.name: Engraving
effects.description: Simulates an engraved print with directional hatching.

effects.name: Exposure
effects.description: Adjusts image exposure, offset, and gamma.

effects.name: Fast Box Blur
effects.description: Applies a fast horizontal or vertical box blur.

effects.name: Fill
effects.description: Overlays a chosen color onto the source.

effects.name: Find Edges
effects.description: Extracts Sobel edges from the image.

effects.name: Fractal Noise
effects.description: Generates fractal, turbulent, or warped noise patterns.

effects.name: Gameboy Effect
effects.description: Applies a Game Boy-style palette with pixelation and dithering.

effects.name: Gamma/Pedestal/Gain
effects.description: Adjusts pedestal, gamma, and gain per channel.

effects.name: Gaussian Blur
effects.description: Applies a horizontal or vertical Gaussian blur.

effects.name: Glasswork
effects.description: Creates patterned frosted glass with procedural distortion.

effects.name: Glow
effects.description: Creates a two-color glow from the source.

effects.name: Gradient Ramp
effects.description: Applies a linear or radial two-color gradient.

effects.name: Grid
effects.description: Draws a configurable grid over the image.

effects.name: Grungify
effects.description: Overlays a boiling stop-motion grunge texture with threshold and overlap controls.

effects.name: HardCorrupt
effects.description: Corrupts the image with displaced, pixelated glitch blocks.

effects.name: HEISEI-VHS
effects.description: Simulates a worn VHS signal.

effects.name: Hexagon Transition
effects.description: Wipes through an expanding hexagonal grid.

effects.name: Hotwave
effects.description: Distorts the layer with animated hot-air waves.

effects.name: HSL Noise
effects.description: Adds procedural noise to hue, saturation, and lightness.

effects.name: HSL Noise Auto
effects.description: Animates procedural noise across hue, saturation, and lightness.

effects.name: Hydrochrome
effects.description: Applies an animated hydrochromic color distortion.

effects.name: Impact Lines
effects.description: Generates animated radial or speed lines.

effects.name: Invert
effects.description: Inverts or remaps selected image channels.

effects.name: Iris Wipe
effects.description: Reveals the layer through a polygonal iris.

effects.name: Iris Wipe V2 (Sharp)
effects.description: Creates a sharp star-shaped iris transition.

effects.name: Kanta Random3D
effects.description: Scatters animated 3D cards through depth with rotation and evolution.

effects.name: KO_BandFill
effects.description: Fills animated geometric bands with distortion and range controls.

effects.name: Leave Color
effects.description: Preserves selected colors while desaturating the rest.

effects.name: Lens Flare
effects.description: Renders a procedural lens flare at a chosen position.

effects.name: Levels
effects.description: Adjusts black points, white points, and gamma.

effects.name: Levels (Individual Controls)
effects.description: Adjusts levels and gamma independently per channel.

effects.name: Linear Wipe
effects.description: Reveals or hides the source along a line.

effects.name: Liquid Glass
effects.description: Creates liquid-glass refraction from the source alpha.

effects.name: Lumetri Color
effects.description: Applies a broad Lumetri-style color grade.

effects.name: MangaTone
effects.description: Creates a manga-toned image with screens and outlines.

effects.name: Median
effects.description: Reduces speckle noise with median filtering.

effects.name: Minimax
effects.description: Applies directional maximum, minimum, opening, or closing filters.

effects.name: Minimax V2
effects.description: Applies a one-pass directional morphological filter.

effects.name: Mosaic
effects.description: Pixelates the image into averaged blocks.

effects.name: Motion Tile
effects.description: Repeats the layer beyond its bounds with mirror tiling.

effects.name: Mt's PixelSorter
effects.description: Sorts pixels by brightness, saturation, hue, or RGB.

effects.name: MultiSlicer
effects.description: Slices the layer into offset horizontal or vertical strips.

effects.name: NES Pixelated
effects.description: Creates NES-style pixel art with an adjustable color count.

effects.name: NeSprite
effects.description: Creates NES-style sprite pixel art.

effects.name: Night Vision
effects.description: Simulates a green night-vision display.

effects.name: Nimble Nimbus
effects.description: Generates an animated procedural cloud texture.

effects.name: Nisai Stroke
effects.description: Applies a stylized multi-directional stroke treatment.

effects.name: Noise
effects.description: Adds animated monochrome or RGB noise.

effects.name: OilFlow
effects.description: Repaints the image as flowing oil paint with bristle texture and glaze.

effects.name: Optics Compensation
effects.description: Corrects or exaggerates lens distortion.

effects.name: Oscilloscope
effects.description: Renders the image as a glowing oscilloscope display.

effects.name: Photocopy Scan Lines
effects.description: Creates a monochrome photocopy with noisy scan lines.

effects.name: Pokémon-style Battle Start Transition
effects.description: Reveals the image in expanding pixel blocks like a retro battle-scene transition.

effects.name: Pro Line Extract
effects.description: Extracts stylized lines with selectable edge modes.

effects.name: proGradient
effects.description: Creates a multi-stop gradient with contour mapping.

effects.name: QC Color Analyzer
effects.description: Displays RGB, HSV, and LCH color analysis.

effects.name: Radial Blur
effects.description: Applies a center-based spin or zoom blur.

effects.name: Radial Wipe
effects.description: Reveals the layer around a radial angle.

effects.name: ReRamp
effects.description: Re-ramps colors through multiple perceptual color stops.

effects.name: Ripple
effects.description: Creates an animated radial ripple distortion.

effects.name: Ripple Transition
effects.description: Wipes through an expanding ripple ring.

effects.name: Risograph
effects.description: Simulates a risograph print with layered inks.

effects.name: S_EdgeColorize
effects.description: Colorizes image edges with four directional colors.

effects.name: S_Glint
effects.description: Adds animated glints to bright source regions.

effects.name: S_Glow
effects.description: Creates a thresholded glow with separated color channels.

effects.name: S_HalfTone
effects.description: Renders a rotated halftone screen with two ink colors.

effects.name: S_Kaleido
effects.description: Creates configurable kaleidoscopic tiling.

effects.name: S_KaleidoPolar
effects.description: Maps the image into repeated polar kaleidoscope sectors.

effects.name: S_KaleidoRadial
effects.description: Generates animated radial kaleidoscope slices.

effects.name: S_Shake

effects.name: S_Shape
effects.description: Draws a configurable polygon or rounded star.

effects.name: S_WipeBlobs
effects.description: Performs a noisy organic blob wipe.

effects.name: S_WipeCells
effects.description: Wipes through animated Voronoi cells.

effects.name: S_WipeDoubleWedge

effects.name: S_WipeFourWedges

effects.name: S_WipeMoire

effects.name: S_WipePixelate
effects.description: Wipes the source through ordered pixel cells.

effects.name: S_WipePlasma
effects.description: Uses animated plasma noise as a wipe field.

effects.name: S_WipeTiles
effects.description: Wipes through morphing geometric tile shapes.

effects.name: S_WipeWeave
effects.description: Creates a woven-strand wipe from animated noise.

effects.name: scl_Film Strip
effects.description: Draws repeated film-strip geometry.

effects.name: Sepia
effects.description: Applies a sepia print treatment.

effects.name: Simple Choker

effects.name: Slice Transition

effects.name: TexGraph
